title: Every engine call of an import is paced from the first one, including cached-handover recovery; the pasted-token webroot probe sends the site's Basic credential only to the origin the customer gave; and a pasted Joomla token met by a Basic challenge asks for the extra password
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/site-link-pacing.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/webroot.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/handover-recovery.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/import-gates.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code, the `# fail` line, and the `ok` line of every test named in run.tests.
expect: Pacing: the first two engine calls of a run (info, door probes) are at least the pacing interval apart, and the cached-handover recovery's engine calls are paced too.

Basic on the webroot probe: a pasted Joomla token sends the Authorization header to the given origin; a redirect to another origin (apex to www, http to https) carries no Authorization; a same-origin redirect keeps it.

Basic challenge: a pasted Joomla token whose admin door answers 401 with a Basic challenge, no engine door answering, is basic_auth_required with check basic_challenge; with no answer at all it stays cowork_not_answering.
evidence: Before the fix the pacing link was created after the door search, so the first engine calls went out back to back and the cached-handover recovery was never paced; the pasted-token webroot probe sent no Basic credential; and a pasted token on a site whose admin asks for a Basic password was told the extension was not answering.
fence: The real run, door, webroot and SiteLink modules against fake site answers with mocked timers. Not shown: a real host with Basic on its admin, a real redirect chain.

tests: the first engine calls of a run share the site link pacing
an apex that 301s to www resolves to www
a same-origin redirect keeps the caller credential
an https webRootUrl retry recovers over https and corrects the handed-over address
a pasted Joomla token sends Basic auth on the webroot probe
a pasted Joomla token with an unanswered Basic challenge asks for the extra password
without it, a Basic challenge asks for the extra password
no answer at all, asked twice, is cowork_not_answering with check network
